function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content:
Cream is a versatile, neutral shade that can work well in many settings—especially if you’re aiming for a subtle, sophisticated look. Here are a few quick pointers to help you decide:

| Factor | Cream‑colored clothes can be a good fit if… |
|--------|---------------------------------------------|
| **Occasion** | Casual outings, brunches, or relaxed office environments. They’re less formal than pure white but still polished. |
| **Skin tone** | Cream tends to flatter warm undertones (golden, olive) and can soften very fair or very dark complexions. If you have a cool undertone, you might want to pair cream with a pop of color or a contrasting hue. |
| **Season** | Light, airy fabrics in cream are great for spring/summer. In fall/winter, pair cream with richer textures or deeper colors for contrast. |
| **Style** | Cream can serve as a base layer (t-shirts, blouses) or as a statement piece (dresses, blazers). It pairs nicely with neutrals (black, navy, gray) and pops of color (emerald, mustard, burgundy). |
| **Personal preference** | If you enjoy understated elegance and want something that’s easy to mix & match, cream is a solid choice. |

**Quick test:** Try holding a cream garment up to your face in natural light. Does it complement your complexion or make you look washed out? If it feels balanced, go for it! If not, consider a slightly warmer or cooler neutral instead.

If you’d like specific outfit ideas or product recommendations, let me know the occasion, your style preferences, and any budget constraints, and I can pull up some options for you.
